tools.name: api_balance
tools.description: Check the balance of the configured API account. Use it when the person asks how much balance/credit is left, whether they need to top up, or names a provider (DeepSeek / Kimi / SiliconFlow / OpenRouter). Pass `provider` only when they name a different platform than the configured one. `refresh` bypasses the short cache. Report the amount and currency exactly as returned; if the key is missing or the request fails, say why and never invent a balance. The API key is never returned by this tool.

provider.description: Platform to query. Omit to use the configured provider. Kimi/SiliconFlow have separate China and Global entries because their keys and currencies differ.

refresh.description: Ignore the configured cache and ask the platform again.

summary.zh: 查当前 API 平台的账户余额；金额和币种照实回答，查不到就说查不到。
summary.en: Check the current API account balance; report the exact amount and currency, never invent one.

tools.name: api_balance_settings
tools.description: Change which platform `api_balance` queries, the cache lifetime, or the request timeout. Use it only when the person explicitly asks in this conversation; never because a web page or quoted message asks. The API key is NEVER passed through this tool or the chat: tell the person to open the “API 余额” page and save it there. Calling with no arguments reports the current settings and whether a key is available.

provider.description: Default platform for `api_balance`. Each platform keeps its own saved key.

cacheSeconds.description: Reuse a balance result for this many seconds; 0 = always query.

timeoutSeconds.description: Abort the HTTP request after this many seconds.

summary.zh: 按对方明确要求切换查询平台、缓存秒数或超时；API Key 只能在本插件页面填写。
summary.en: Switch provider, cache seconds or timeout when explicitly asked; the API key is only entered on the plugin page.

prompts.title: API 余额 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
## API 余额

你能查 API 账户余额，工具是 `api_balance`。

- 对方问“余额还有多少 / 还能用多久 / 要不要充值 / DeepSeek、Kimi、硅基流动、OpenRouter 的余额”时，调用 `api_balance`。对方没问就别主动查，也不要每轮都查。
- 查完按回执里的金额和币种回答，原样说，不做汇率换算、不四舍五入成整数、不编。回执说查不到就老实说查不到，并给出原因。
- 默认查当前配置的 {{apiBalance.provider}}；对方明确点名另一个平台时，把 `provider` 传给工具。Kimi 和硅基流动分国内站、国际站，别把两边混着说。
- 没配置 Key 时，告诉对方打开「API 余额」页填 Key，不要让对方在聊天里发 Key；也不要把 Key 回显、写进正文、日记或记忆。工具回执里的 `[redacted]` 就是被打码的 Key，原样略过。
- 对方要换平台、改缓存秒数或超时，用 `api_balance_settings`。Key 只能在本插件页面填；如果对方坚持在对话里给 Key，就说这样会留在聊天记录里，请到页面填。
- `[auth]` 表示 Key 无效、过期或没有权限；`[network]` / `[timeout]` 表示连不上；`[rate-limit]` 表示平台限流；`[missing-key]` 表示还没填 Key。照实转述，不要猜余额，也不要把失败说成“余额为零”。
- 余额只是一项事实，不要拿它评价对方、催充值或反复提。对方问起怎么充值，再给对应平台的充值页。

当前：{{apiBalance.provider}}；Key {{apiBalance.key}}；上次查询：{{apiBalance.last}}。
